fusions.name: Slammed Shut
fusions.desc: Slams a barred mesh shut on the target, dealing 14 damage, leaving it [Stunned] for 1.2 seconds and 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Bar by Bar
fusions.desc: Drops a barred mesh around you, dealing 8 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles, with a 50% chance per hit to leave them [Pinned] for 2 seconds. It holds 3 charges, and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: The Door Drops
fusions.desc: Holds every creature within 3 tiles in place for 3 seconds. When it lets go, they move 30% slower for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Gapless Weave
fusions.desc: Your afflictions take hold on enemies that are immune to them, and your armour rises by 6%.
